objective: Wait for Loramus to complete the enlightenment spell.

description: You are foolhardy, <name>. It is an admirable quality of your kind - to blindly enter battle when you have little to no chance of success. I will assist you, if only to see just one of Razelikh's minions fall.
To break the ward placed over Razelikh's subordinates will take time and require the acquisition of rare artifacts.
Be still, I must first perform the enlightenment ritual. The information I gather will assist me in forging weapons of great power.
completion: The name of the beast must be found.
